bundle.shortDescription: Diagrams as code, with a canvas you are allowed to touch
bundle.longDescription: ZDraft renders Mermaid, Graphviz, D2 and PlantUML and then lets you drag the nodes auto-layout got wrong. The move is persisted as a layout hint in a readable TOML sidecar next to your source — so the diagram file stays exactly what the engine expects, GitHub still renders it, and the diff a reviewer reads is still text. Entirely local, entirely offline.
